spec.name: Trend v5
spec.notes: Twelve-month return skipping the most recent weeks, long the strongest fifth.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.9, annual return 8%, maximum drawdown 11%.

exhibits.summary: Delaying the signal by 1 more bar moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.91 to 1.96 (change +0.05).
Under strict point-in-time data the Sharpe ratio moves from 1.91 to 1.91. Strict mode changed no field or operator the signal uses.
At 10 bps the Sharpe ratio is 1.88 (as submitted, 5 bps: 1.91); it breaks even at above 200 bps with daily turnover 0.01.
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 1.91 against 1.91 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.
On the sealed period (strict mode, 10 bps) the Sharpe ratio is 2.94 against 1.91 in research, a gap of -1.03.
The best year gives 23% of total P&L (year 2) and calm regimes give 216%; Sharpe is 6.74 in calm and -8.08 in stressed regimes.
The log holds 3 distinct specs; the best of 3 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.08, so the claimed 1.90 becomes 1.82 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 100%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 1.95 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean -0.02, 95th percentile 0.53).
Perturbing the 2 numeric values in the signal by up to 50% moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.91 to as low as 1.68 (as low as 1.68 at 25%).
The top 1% of days (21 days) give 22% of total P&L and the top 5 assets give 19% (net of the strategy's own costs).

series.label: cumulative share of P&L, best days first
